candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0) across all sampled traces, causing order POST /v1/orders to return 503 and gateway checkout to time out and return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side traces/logs/metrics were excluded from context; pool saturation is inferred from gateway-side spans only. Root cause of the pool exhaustion (leak vs load vs config) is not established.

report.explanation: All three sampled checkout traces show the same chain: inventory and payment succeed, then postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, order returns 503, and gateway's POST /v1/orders hits a ~2s ReadTimeout yielding 502 at /v1/checkout. Gateway metrics confirm 502s and ~2.4s p95 on /v1/checkout while /readyz stays healthy. The order deployment record (v1.0.0, no previous version) does not establish deployment causation.
